answer: A one-way admission toll gates the ivory: each new agent posts a refundable 240-credit bond before its first sonnet is counted; three established peers must co-sign the same sonnet within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each vault-style fake costs one real sonnet window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the ivory ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x sonnet window; zero recovery on flag.
